lemma maximal_maximalSeparatedSet (h : packingNumber ε A ≠ ⊤) :
    Maximal (fun N ↦ N ⊆ A ∧ IsSeparated ε N) (maximalSeparatedSet ε A) := by
  refine ⟨⟨maximalSeparatedSet_subset, isSeparated_maximalSeparatedSet⟩, fun N hN hsub ↦ ?_⟩
  have hfin : (maximalSeparatedSet ε A).Finite :=
    Set.encard_ne_top_iff.mp ((card_maximalSeparatedSet h).trans_ne h)
  exact (hfin.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le hsub
    ((hN.2.encard_le_packingNumber hN.1).trans (card_maximalSeparatedSet h).ge)).ge

/-- The maximal separated set is a cover. -/
lemma isCover_maximalSeparatedSet (h : packingNumber ε A ≠ ⊤) :
    IsCover ε A (maximalSeparatedSet ε A) :=
  .of_maximal_isSeparated (maximal_maximalSeparatedSet h)
